description: This file provides utility functions for file path searching, directory finding, and filename sanitization within the Mattermost project.

methods.name: CommonBaseSearchPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of common relative search paths for locating files or directories.

methods.name: findPath
methods.description: Internal function that searches for a file or directory in specified base paths, considering working directory and binary location.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Public wrapper for findPath, searches with working directory prioritized.

methods.name: FindFile
methods.description: Searches for a file in ancestor directories and the executable's directory.

methods.name: FindDir
methods.description: Searches for a directory in ancestor directories and defaults to './' if not found.

methods.name: FindDirRelBinary
methods.description: Searches for a directory relative to the binary's location, then working directory, defaults to './'.

methods.name: SanitizeFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to create a safe filename by removing unsafe characters and limiting length.
